description: This file defines the NotificationGroup class, which models the '<notification-group>' element in an XML configuration related to the OFBiz framework. It manages notification details and a list of notify elements, providing accessors for these properties.

classes.name: NotificationGroup
classes.description: A thread-safe class that models the '<notification-group>' XML element, containing a name, a notification, and a list of notify objects.

methods.name: NotificationGroup
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object from an XML Element, validating presence of required sub-elements and attributes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the notification group.

methods.name: getNotifyList
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of Notify objects.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name attribute of the notification group.

fields.name: notification
fields.description: The Notification object associated with this group.

fields.name: notifyList
fields.description: Immutable list of Notify objects within the group.

methods.name: NotificationGroup
methods.description: Initializes a NotificationGroup instance from an XML element, parsing and validating required sub-elements and attributes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the notification group.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves the Notification object associated with the group.

methods.name: getNotifyList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of Notify objects associated with the group.
